text:
maria: Kicking off bring-up for HeliosHealth private cluster in SIN-1 (air-gapped on-prem). Target window: Tue 09:00 SGT (48h). Customer committed 8x A100s, private control plane, BGP to their edge router. I put a draft checklist below — please call out missing validation steps or network gotchas.

devon: noted. who has the customer network creds? we need the VLAN IDs, BGP ASN, and the /29 public range for NAT. also confirm whether they want MTU 9000 for nvlink.

maria: I have a subset of creds in lastpass (shared with infra-team). Helios confirmed MTU 9000 and a local ASN 64521. Customer provided a management jumpbox at 10.10.0.5 (SSH key).

sahil: plan to seed images via USB staging host then scp into the isolated site. suggested flow:
```
# on staging host
scp -r ./seed_images helios@10.10.0.5:/opt/seed_images
ssh helios@10.10.0.5 'sudo /opt/seed_images/install.sh --airgap'
```
make sure image checksums are signed. ops-bot will verify after upload.

ops-bot: image-upload-checksum: OK (sha256 verified).

devon: network validation items I want in the checklist:
- BGP adjacency established and routes learned (show ip bgp summary)
- Customer route propagation to K8s nodes for podCIDR and serviceCIDR
- NAT rule for control-plane telemetry egress (per compliance)
- NTP and CA sync to our KMS gateway IPs
- MTU path MTU check for 9000 frames

elaine: infra acceptance tests (quick list):
- kube-apiserver health /live and /ready on all masters
- nodes show Ready and have GPU plugin active (nvidia-smi visible)
- run small inference pod using redwood-serving: image pulled from local registry, test with tiny model, assert latency < 200ms for 1-token warm run
- KV cache integration smoke: cold-start then repeat request should be ~2x faster

maria: adding cost note: Helios will be billed reserved capacity. For our internal ops runbook, estimate infra burn ~= $9–12/hr per A100 equivalent for edge (power + racks + network). include that in SOW.

sahil: here are a couple of quick commands for validation once nodes are up:
```
# BGP
vtysh -c 'show ip bgp summary'
# MTU test
ping -s 8972 -M do 10.10.0.1
# kube checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving
# GPU plugin
kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i nvidia
```

devon: two gotchas we've seen in SIN sites:
1) vendor switch defaults to LACP on trunk ports — make sure it's disabled or matches our config.
2) Some customer firewalls drop TCP MSS < 1400 causing TLS fragmentation. test with larger payloads.

maria: ops step to enable NVLink peer topology for multi-GPU jobs: set vendor firmware to allow PCIe peer access (we've got a firmware patch; staging ID FW-2025-07). schedule outside business hours.

vic: will set up a 60min KT with Helios network team Wednesday 14:00 SGT. please add me to the meeting and drop a quick agenda.

elaine: handoff/DRI plan:
- day 0 (bring-up): infra-team + devex on-site remote for image staging
- day 1: run acceptance tests, stress test 24h with synthetic load (simulated 300 qps), collect perf traces
- day 2: handover to Helios ops with 2-week on-call by Redwood (elaine and sahil).

maria: acceptance stress test commands (example):
```
# run stress worker (local)
redwoodctl stress --target http://10.10.1.20:8080/generate --concurrency 50 --duration 24h --payload '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# collect token-level latency histogram
redwoodctl traces export --since 1h > traces.json
```

devon: for the private control plane, we need to validate HSM/KMS connectivity through their gateway. customer says HSM->our control plane is allowed but only on port 8443. ensure backups are encrypted with their KMS key.

maria: checklist (final draft):
1) Pre-stage images & verify checksums (sahil)
2) BGP adjacency + route validation (devon)
3) MTU + MSS path tests (devon)
4) Provision k8s control plane & join nodes (maria)
5) Install NVIDIA drivers and runtime + validate nvidia-smi (sahil)
6) Deploy local registry and pull redwood-serving images (sahil)
7) Run infra acceptance tests + stress (elaine)
8) NVLink & PCIe peer validation (maria)
9) KMS/HSM connectivity and backup encryption (devon)
10) Cost / SOW confirmation and billing setup (bizops)

elaine: I'll own 5–7, sahil will do 1 & 6, devon 2–3 & 9, maria owns 4 & 8. ops-bot will create the checklists as tasks.

ops-bot: tasklist created: https://tasks.internal/edge/1815234567 (Helios bring-up)

maria: last call for anything else? also flagging a rollback plan: if GPU nodes fail GPU plugin validation, we revert to maintenance mode and connect traffic to fallback hosted model pool in us-west until we troubleshoot. we should verify fallbacks before handoff.

devon: agree. i'll prepare the fallback routing policy — prefer local then fallback to dedicated-us-west, TTL 30s, and a rate limit to protect remote site.

sahil: I pushed the signed seed images to the staging host. ops-bot verified signatures. ready for staging window Tue 09:00.

maria: perfect. thanks team. if no objections, i'll send calendar invites and the customer KT invite. :thumbsup:
